(knidanuvartanaksepe slokavartikan) suwtve knidaDikarascecCa satvan suwtve knidaDaikarascet Ca satvan vaktavyan praswa, praswun, praswavyan (knidanuvartanaksepe slokavartikan) tukprasangasca tuk ca prasajyeta nivrtepi vE knidgrahanevasyanatra tugaBavarTo yatna kartavya antarangatvadDi tuk prapnoti cCvo iti tuka saha sanipatagrahanan vijnayate nanu cEvanapi antyasya prapnoti sanipatagrahanasarnaTyatsarvasya Bavisyati evanapyangasya prapnoti nirdisyananasyadesa Bavantiti - evanangasya na Bavisyati yadyevanutpucCayaterapratyaya utpuq iti prapnoti, utpuditi cesyate taTa vanCaterapratyaya -van, vansO, vansa iti na siDyati yaTalaksananaprayukte tatra tvetavan visesa - anuvartanane knidgrahane Ca satvan vaktavyan, tatra capi sanipatagrahanan vijneyan (knidgrahanananuvartanaksepe slokavartikan) nivrte diva uWBava aTa nivrtan diva uWBava prapnoti dyuByan dyuBi astu kaTan dyuByan - dyuBi iti ? uWi krte diva ut [6.1.131] ityutvan Bavisyati na siDyati antaryato dirGasya dirGa prapnoti (knidgrahanananuvartane dosanivarakan slokavartikan) tadarTan tapara krta tadarTan tapara kriyate (sangraha) suwtve knidaDikarascecCa satvan tukprasajyate nivrte diva uWBavastadarTan tapara krta (knidgrahananuvartane dosanivarakan Basyan) kva puna knidgrahanan prakrtan ? anunasikasya kviJalo kniti (15) iti yadi tadanuvartate, ajJanaganan sani (16) kviJalosceti kviJalorapi dirGatvan prapnoti Jali tavana dosa sananatra Jalgrahanena visesayisyana -sani Jaladaviti kvavapyacaryapravrtirjnapayati - nanena kvO dirGatvan Bavatiti, yadayan kvibvacipracCyayatastukawaprujusrinan dirGosanprasaranan ceti dirGatvan sasti iti srinadBagavatpatanjaliviracite vyakarananahaBasye sasWaDyayasya caturTe pade praTananahnikan
ck: cvo sutanunasike ca (3017) (utotikaranan) (utastitvasatakapasyan) ata utati kasnana pavati, atistit pavatiti prapnoti kasya punarati ? vakarasya astu vakarasya ka pratipati ? lopo vyorvali [6.1.6] iti lopo pavisyati nEvan sakyan cvaratvarasrivyavinavanupatayasca [6.4.20] iti tvavutO syatan evan tarhi nEsa tit kastarhi ? tit (titve aksepapariharapasyan) yati tarhi tati, tOta pata iti etyetatyutsu [6.1.89] iti vrtirna prapnoti cartve krte pavisyati asitan rcatvan tasyasitatvana prapnoti asrayatsitatvan pavisyati asatyanyasninasrayatsitatvan syat, asti canya vaha ut iti esopi titkarisyate tatropayorscatve krte asrayatsitatvan pavisyati (knitanuvartanavicarapasyan) ata knitkrahanananuvartate, utaho na ? kincata ? (knitanuvartanaksepe slokavartikan) sutve knitatikarasceca satvan sutve knitataikarascet ca satvan vaktavyan prasta, prastun, prastavyan (knitanuvartanaksepe slokavartikan) tukprasankasca tuk ca prasacyeta nivrtepi vE knitkrahanevasyanatra tukapavarto yatna kartavya antarankatvati tuk prapnoti cvo iti tuka saha sanipatakrahanan vicnayate nanu cEvanapi antyasya prapnoti sanipatakrahanasarnatyatsarvasya pavisyati evanapyankasya prapnoti nirtisyananasyatesa pavantiti - evanankasya na pavisyati yatyevanutpucayaterapratyaya utput iti prapnoti, utputiti cesyate tata vancaterapratyaya -van, vansO, vansa iti na sityati yatalaksananaprayukte tatra tvetavan visesa - anuvartanane knitkrahane ca satvan vaktavyan, tatra capi sanipatakrahanan vicneyan (knitkrahanananuvartanaksepe slokavartikan) nivrte tiva utpava ata nivrtan tiva utpava prapnoti tyupyan tyupi astu katan tyupyan - tyupi iti ? uti krte tiva ut [6.1.131] ityutvan pavisyati na sityati antaryato tirkasya tirka prapnoti (knitkrahanananuvartane tosanivarakan slokavartikan) tatartan tapara krta tatartan tapara kriyate (sankraha) sutve knitatikarasceca satvan tukprasacyate nivrte tiva utpavastatartan tapara krta (knitkrahananuvartane tosanivarakan pasyan) kva puna knitkrahanan prakrtan ? anunasikasya kvicalo kniti (15) iti yati tatanuvartate, acanakanan sani (16) kvicalosceti kvicalorapi tirkatvan prapnoti cali tavana tosa sananatra calkrahanena visesayisyana -sani calataviti kvavapyacaryapravrtircnapayati - nanena kvO tirkatvan pavatiti, yatayan kvipvacipracyayatastukataprucusrinan tirkosanprasaranan ceti tirkatvan sasti iti srinatpakavatpatancaliviracite vyakarananahapasye sastatyayasya caturte pate pratananahnikan

pk: snanalopa (3021) (lopaDikaranan) (sakaraprayojanaBasyan) aTa kinarTan snana sakarasya grahanan kriyate, na nanalopa ityevocyeta ? nanalopa itiyatyucyanane - nandita, nandaka - ityatrapi prasajyeta evan tarhi evan vaksyani - nanaloponiditan tata - hala upaDaya knititi, aniditaniti nEvan sakyan iha hi na syat - hinasti tasnanEvan sakyan na cedevan -nandita -nandaka -ityatrapi prasajyeta evan tarhi knititi vartate evanapi hinasti - ityatra na prapnoti nEsa parasaptani ka tarhi ? satsaptani - kniti sati evanapi - nandanana - ityatrapi prapnoti evan tarhi nasabda evatra knitvena visesyateknicenasabdo Bavatiti evanapi - yajnanan - yatnanan - ityatra prapnoti dirGatvanatra baDakan Bavisyati idaniha sanpraDaryan - dirGatvan kriyatan - nalopa iti, kinatra kartavyan ? paratvanalopa tasnat sakarasya grahanan kartavyan (sakaragrahane dosanivarakaBasyan) aTa kriyananepi sakaragrahane iha kasnana Bavati - visnanan - prasnanan - iti ? laksanapratipadoktayo pratipadoktasyEvetyevan na Bavisyati

pk: janasanaKanan sanJalo (3040) (sanJaloranvayaksepaBasyan) aTa kinayan sanucaya - sani ca JaladO ceti, ahosvit sanvisesanan Jalgrahanan - sani Jaladaviti ? kin cata ? (sanucaye dosaBasyan) yadi sanucaya, sanyaJaladavapi prapnoti sisanisati, jijanisate, ciKanisati (visesanapakse dosaBasyan) aTa sanvisesanan Jalgrahanan, jata - jatavanityatra na prapnoti yaTecCasi taTastu (sanucaye dosanivarakaBasyan) astu tavatsanucaya nanu coktan - sanyaJaladavapi prapnoti nEsa dosa prakrtan Jalgrahanananuvartate, tena sanan visesayisyana - sani Jaladaviti (visesanapakse dosanivarakaBasyan) aTa va punarastu sanvisesanan kaTan jata - jatavaniti ? prakrtan Jali knitityanuvartate (JalgrahanapratyaKyanaBasyan) yadyevan narTo Jalgrahanena yogaviBaga karisyate - janasanaKanan anunasikasyakaro Bavati Jali kniti tata - sani ca sani ca janasanaKanananunasikasyakaro Bavati, Jalityeva tasnanarTo Jalgrahanena (6543 vipratiseDavartikan 1 ) - sanoteranunasikalopadatvan vipratiseDena - sanoteranunasikalopadatvan Bavati vipratiseDena sanoteranunasikalopasyavakasa - anye tanotyadaya atvasyavakasa - anye janadaya sanoteranunasikasyoBayan prapnoti - sata, satavan - iti atvan Bavati vipratiseDena (vipratiseDaksepaBasyan) nEsa yukto vipratiseDa na hi sanoteranunasikalopasyanye tanotyadayovakasa sanoteryastanotyadisu paWa sonavakasa na Kalvapyatvasyanye janadayovakasa sanoteryadatve grahanan tadanavakasan, tasyanavakasatvadayukto vipratiseDa (sakarakarayorvipratiseDopapadanaBasyan) evan tarhi tanotyadisu paWastavatsavakasa kovakasa anyani tanotyadikaryani - tanadiByastaTaso [2.4.79] iti atvepi grahanan savakasan kovakasa ? sani ca ye viBasa [6.4.43] ca uBayo savakasayoryukto vipratiseDa (vipratiseDaksepaBasyan) evanapyayukto vipratiseDa paWisyati hyacarya - purvatrasidDe nasti vipratiseDoBavadutarasya iti ekasya hi nanaBave vipratiseDo na syat, kin punaryatroBayan nasti (jnapakena vipratiseDasTapanaBasyan) nEsa dosa Bavatiha vipratiseDa kin vaktavyanetat ? na hi kaTananucyananan gansyate ? acaryapravrtirjnapayati - Bavatiha vipratiseDa iti, yadayan GunasTagapajahatisan hali [6.4.6] iti halgrahanan karoti kaTan krtva jnapakan ? halgrahanasyEtatprayojanan - haladavitvan yaTa syat, iha na But - goda - kanbalada iti yadi catra vipratiseDo na syadiha halgrahanananarTakan syat astvatra irtvan irtvasyasidDatvalopo Bavisyati pasyati tvacarya - Bavatiha vipratiseDa, tato halgrahanan karoti (irtvasya vyavasTarTatvaboDanena jnapakanirakaranaBasyan) nEtadasti jnapakan, vyavasTarTanetatsyat - haladavitvan yaT
ck: canasanakanan sancalo (3040) (sancaloranvayaksepapasyan) ata kinayan sanucaya - sani ca calatO ceti, ahosvit sanvisesanan calkrahanan - sani calataviti ? kin cata ? (sanucaye tosapasyan) yati sanucaya, sanyacalatavapi prapnoti sisanisati, cicanisate, cikanisati (visesanapakse tosapasyan) ata sanvisesanan calkrahanan, cata - catavanityatra na prapnoti yatecasi tatastu (sanucaye tosanivarakapasyan) astu tavatsanucaya nanu coktan - sanyacalatavapi prapnoti nEsa tosa prakrtan calkrahanananuvartate, tena sanan visesayisyana - sani calataviti (visesanapakse tosanivarakapasyan) ata va punarastu sanvisesanan katan cata - catavaniti ? pk: nisWayan sewi (3050) (padakrtyaBasyan) aTa seqgrahanan kinarTan ? nisWayan seqgrahanananiwi pratiseDarTan nisWayan seqgrahanan kriyate aniwi pratiseDo yaTa syaditi sanjnapita pasuriti (6549 seqgrahananarTakyaboDakavartikan 1 ) - nisWayan seqgrahanananiwi pratiseDarTaniti cetatsidDan - nisWayan seqgrahanananiwi pratiseDarTaniti cedantarenapi seqgrahanan tatsidDan kaTan ? aniqaBavat (aniqaBavaksepe vartikavataranaBasyan) nanu ca yasya viBasa [7.2.15] iti jnaperiwi्pratiseDa (650 aniqaBavasaDakavartikan 2 ) - ekaco hi pratiseDa - ekaco hi sa pratiseDa jnapiscanekac (651 sewgrahanaprayojanavartikan 3 ) - iqBavarTan tu taninitatvalopasya - iqBavarTan tarhi seqgrahanan kriyate kaTan puna sewityane new sakyo Bavayitun ? taninitatvalopasya natrakrte iwi nilopena Bavitavyan kin karanan ? sewityucyate (652 sewgrahanaBave dosavartikan 4 ) - avacane hi nilopa iwpratiseDaprasanga - akriyanane hi seqgrahane nilope krte ekaca itiwpratiseDa prasajyeta karitan, haritan (yogaviBagena sutrapratyaKyanaBasyan) evan tarhi narTa seqgrahanena, napi sutrena kaTan ? saptane yogaviBaga karisyate idanasti - nisWayan [7.2.14], new Bavati tata - ne nyantasya nisWayan new Bavati karitan haritan tata - vrtan vrtaniti ca nipatyate (kin nipatyate ? nernisWayan lopo nipatyate ) kin prayojanan ? niyanarTan atrEva nisWayan nerlopo Bavati nanyatra kva na But ? karitan haritan ihapi tarhi prapnoti - vartitananan, vartita Biksa tata - aDyayane aDyayane cet vrtirvartate iti (653 upasanKyanavartikan 5 ) - vrDiranisrDinanupasanKyanan sarvaDatukatvat - vrDiranisrDinanupasanKyanan kartavyan kin karanan ? sarvaDatukatvat varDantu tva suswutayo giro ne, varDayantu ityevan prapte brhaspatiswva sune ranatu, ranayatu ityevan prapte agne sardDa nahate sOBagaya, sardDayeti prapte (upasanKyananarTakyaboDakaBasyan) tatarhi vaktavyan na vaktavyan vrDiranisrDinanarDaDatukatvatsidDan kaTanarDaDatukatvan ? anyepi hi Datupratyaya uBayaTa Candasi drsyante
ck: nistayan seti (3050) (patakrtyapasyan) ata setkrahanan kinartan ? nistayan setkrahanananiti pratisetartan nistayan setkrahanan kriyate aniti pratiseto yata syatiti sancnapita pasuriti (6549 setkrahananartakyapotakavartikan 1 ) - nistayan setkrahanananiti pratisetartaniti cetatsitan - nistayan setkrahanananiti pratisetartaniti cetantarenapi setkrahanan tatsitan katan ? anitapavat (anitapavaksepe vartikavataranapasyan) nanu ca yasya vipasa [7.2.15] iti cnaperiti्pratiseta (650 anitapavasatakavartikan 2 ) - ekaco hi pratiseta - ekaco hi sa pratiseta cnapiscanekac (651 setkrahanaprayocanavartikan 3 ) - itpavartan tu taninitatvalopasya - itpavartan tarhi setkrahanan kriyate katan puna setityane net sakyo pavayitun ? taninitatvalopasya natrakrte iti nilopena pavitavyan kin karanan ? setityucyate (652 setkrahanapave tosavartikan 4 ) - avacane hi nilopa itpratisetaprasanka - akriyanane hi setkrahane nilope krte ekaca ititpratiseta prasacyeta karitan, haritan (yokavipakena sutrapratyakyanapasyan) evan tarhi narta setkrahanena, napi sutrena katan ? saptane yokavipaka karisyate itanasti - nistayan [7.2.14], net pavati tata - ne nyantasya nistayan net pavati karitan haritan tata - vrtan vrtaniti ca nipatyate (kin nipatyate ? nernistayan lopo nipatyate ) kin prayocanan ? niyanartan atrEva nistayan nerlopo pavati nanyatra kva na put ? karitan haritan ihapi tarhi prapnoti - vartitananan, vartita piksa tata - atyayane atyayane cet vrtirvartate iti (653 upasankyanavartikan 5 ) - vrtiranisrtinanupasankyanan sarvatatukatvat - vrtiranisrtinanupasankyanan kartavyan kin karanan ? sarvatatukatvat vartantu tva sustutayo kiro ne, vartayantu ityevan prapte prhaspatistva sune ranatu, ranayatu ityevan prapte akne sarta nahate sOpakaya, sartayeti prapte (upasankyananartakyapotakapasyan) tatarhi vaktavyan na vaktavyan vrtiranisrtinanartatatukatvatsitan katanartatatukatvan ? anyepi hi tatupratyaya upayata cantasi trsyante

ck: syasicsiyutasisu pavakarnanorupatesecanakrahatrsan va cinvatit ca (3060) (pavakarnanorvisaye paksatvayopastapakan pasyan) (cinvatpavatikaranan) katanitan vicnayate pavakarnanorye syataya iti, ahosvitpavakarnavacini parato ye syataya iti ? kincata ? yati vicnayate - pavakarnanorye syataya iti, siyut visesita, syasicutasayovisesita ata vicnayate - pavakarnavacini parato ye syataya iti, syasictasayo visesita, siyutavisesita upayata cinvatpavovisesita yatecasi tatastu (pratanapakse tosavarakapasyan) astu - pavakarnanorye syataya iti nanu coktan - siyut visesita, syasictasayovisesita iti syasictasayasca visesita katan ? pavakarnavacini parata siyut nastiti krtva pavakarnavacini siyuti karyan vicnasyate (itsanpantinirnayopakranapasyan) ata it ca ityucyate, kasyayanit pavati ? ankasyeti vartate yatyevanankasyatita it prapnoti, atatvat tatyata - atatO titvatatito pavata (itsanpantyaksepapasyan) evan tarhi syatinan pavisyati evanapi sastyapavana prapnoti nanu ca pavakarnano ityesa sasti nEsa sasti kin tarhi ? ck: sapurvahantrtaracnanani (313) (lopatikaranan) (sapurvatikrahane paksatvayopastapakan pasyan) ata kinitan sapurvatinan punarvacananalopartanahosviniyanartan katan va alopartan, katan va niyanartan ? yatyavisesenalopatilopayo prakrtipavastato vityartan ata hi ani tilopasyEva prakrtipavastato niyanartan ata utaran patati - (606 alopapaksastapakavartikan 1 ) - sapurvatinan punarvacananalopartan - sapurvatinan punarvacanan kriyate alopartan avisesenalopatilopayo prakrtipava (607 niyanapakse tosatarsakan vartikan 2 ) - avatarane hyanyatra prakrtipava upatalopaprasanka - avatarane hi anyatra prakrtipave upatalopa prasacyeta katan ? yati tavatevan niyana syat - sapurvatinanevaniti evanapi pavetiha niyanana syat - sanana vEnana iti taksanya ityatra prapnoti atapyevan niyana syat - sapurvatinananyeveti evanapi pavetiha niyanana syat - taksanya iti sanano vEnana ityatra tu prapnoti atapyupayato niyana syat - sapurvatinanevani, anyeva sapurvatinaniti evanapi sananyo venanya iti prapnoti tasnatsustucyate - sapurvatinan punarvacananalopartanavatarane hyanyatra prakrtipava upatalopaprasanka iti

pk: nastadDite (3142) (61 upasanKyanavartikan 1 ) - nantasya wilope sabrahnacaripiWasarpikalapikuTunitEtilijajalilangalisilalisiKanqisukarasadnasuparvananupasanKyanan - nakarantasya wilope sabrahnacarin piWasarpinkalapinkuTunintEtilinjajalinlangalinsilalinsiKanqinsukarasadnansuparvan - ityetesanupasanKyanan kartavyan sabrahnacarin - sabrahnacarina ine - sabrahnacara sabrahnacarin piWasarpin - pEWasarpa piWasarpin kalapin - kalapa kalapin kuTunin - kOTuna kuTunin tEtilin - tEtila tEtilin jajalin - jajala jajalin langalin - langala langalin silalin - sElala silalin siKanqin - sOKanqa siKanqin sukarasadnan - sOkarasadna sukarasadnan suparvan - sOparva suparvan (upasanKyanaBasyan) carnana kosa upasanKyanan kartavyan carna kosa (upasanKyanaBasyan) asnano vikara upasanKyanan kartavyan asnano vikara asna suna sankoce sOva sankoca (612 upasanKyanavartikan 1 ) - avyayanan ca sayanpratikadyarTan - avyayanan ca sayanpratikadyarTanupasanKyanan kartavyan kin prayojanan ? sayanpratikadyarTan sayanpratika, pOna punika (atiprasaktinirasaBasyan) sansvatike pratiseDo vaktavya na vaktavya nipatanadetatsidDan kin nipatanan ? yesan ca viroDa sasvatika [2.4.9] iti evan tarhi - sasvate pratiseDo vaktavya sasvatan
ck: nastatite (3142) (61 upasankyanavartikan 1 ) - nantasya tilope saprahnacaripitasarpikalapikutunitEtilicacalilankalisilalisikantisukarasatnasuparvananupasankyanan - nakarantasya tilope saprahnacarin pitasarpinkalapinkutunintEtilincacalinlankalinsilalinsikantinsukarasatnansuparvan - ityetesanupasankyanan kartavyan saprahnacarin - saprahnacarina ine - saprahnacara saprahnacarin pitasarpin - pEtasarpa pitasarpin kalapin - kalapa kalapin kutunin - kOtuna kutunin tEtilin - tEtila tEtilin cacalin - cacala cacalin lankalin - lankala lankalin silalin - sElala silalin sikantin - sOkanta sikantin sukarasatnan - sOkarasatna sukarasatnan suparvan - sOparva suparvan (upasankyanapasyan) carnana kosa upasankyanan kartavyan carna kosa (upasankyanapasyan) asnano vikara upasankyanan kartavyan asnano vikara asna suna sankoce sOva sankoca (612 upasankyanavartikan 1 ) - avyayanan ca sayanpratikatyartan - avyayanan ca sayanpratikatyartanupasankyanan kartavyan kin prayocanan ? sayanpratikatyartan sayanpratika, pOna punika (atiprasaktinirasapasyan) sansvatike pratiseto vaktavya na vaktavya nipatanatetatsitan kin nipatanan ? yesan ca virota sasvatika [2.4.9] iti evan tarhi - sasvate pratiseto vaktavya sasvatan

pk: yasyeti ca (3146) (sutraprayojanaBasyan) ivarnasya-irti kinudaharanan ? he daksi, daksya, dakseya he daksi -irti - yadi lopo na syatparasya hrasvatve krte savarnadirGatvan prasajyeta daksya iti - yadi lopo na syatparasya yanadese krte purvasya sravanan prasajyeta dakseya iti - yadi lopo na syatparasya lope krte purvasya sravanan prasajyeta (prayojananirakaranaBasyan) nEtani santi prayojanani savarnadirGatvenapyetani sidDani (prayojanaBasyan) idan tarhi - atisaKeragacCati, atisaKe svan yadi lopo na syadupasarjanahrasvatve krte asaKi iti pratiseDa prasajyeta (613 pratiseDopasanKyanavartikan 1 ) - yasyetyadO syan pratiseDa - yasyetyadO syan pratiseDo vaktavya kanqe, kuqye, sOrye nana hinavata srnge sa tarhi pratiseDo vaktavya (upasanKyananarTakyaboDakaBasyan) na vaktavya iha syanityapi prakrtan netyapi tatraBisanbanDanatran kartavyan - yasyetyadO lopo Bavati, syan na (614 vipratiseDopasanKyanavartikan 2 ) - iyanuvanByan lopo vipratiseDena - iyanuvanByan lopo Bavati vipratiseDena iyanuvanoravakasa - sriyO, sriya BruvO, Bruva lopasyavakasa - kananqaleya, Badravaheya ihoBayan prapnoti - vatsapreya, lEKaBreya lopo Bavati vipratiseDena (615 vipratiseDopasanKyanavartikan 3 ) - gunavrdDi ca - gunavrdDi ceyanuvanByan Bavato vipratiseDena gunavrdDyoravakasa - ceta, gO iyanuvano sa eva ihoBayan prapnoti - cayanan, cayaka lavanan, lavaka gunavrdDi Bavato vipratiseDena (616 vipratiseDapratyaKyanavartikan 4 ) - na veyanuvanadesasyanyavisayavacanat - na varTo vipratiseDena kin karanan ? iyanuvanadesasyanyavisaye vacanat iyanuvanadesonyavisaye araByate kin visaye ? yanadesavisaye sa yaTEva yanadesan baDate, evan gunavrdDi api baDeta (617 pratiseDopasanKyanavartikan 5 ) - tasnatatra gunavrdDivisaye pratiseDa - tasnatatra gunavrdDivisaye pratiseDo vaktavya (pratiseDanarTakyaboDakaBasyan) na vaktavya naDyepavada purvan viDin baDanta ityevaniyanuvanadeso yanadesan baDisyate, gunavrdDi na baDisyate
ck: yasyeti ca (3146) (sutraprayocanapasyan) ivarnasya-irti kinutaharanan ? he taksi, taksya, takseya he taksi -irti - yati lopo na syatparasya hrasvatve krte savarnatirkatvan prasacyeta taksya iti - yati lopo na syatparasya yanatese krte purvasya sravanan prasacyeta takseya iti - yati lopo na syatparasya lope krte purvasya sravanan prasacyeta (prayocananirakaranapasyan) nEtani santi prayocanani savarnatirkatvenapyetani sitani (prayocanapasyan) itan tarhi - atisakerakacati, atisake svan yati lopo na syatupasarcanahrasvatve krte asaki iti pratiseta prasacyeta (613 pratisetopasankyanavartikan 1 ) - yasyetyatO syan pratiseta - yasyetyatO syan pratiseto vaktavya kante, kutye, sOrye nana hinavata srnke sa tarhi pratiseto vaktavya (upasankyananartakyapotakapasyan) na vaktavya iha syanityapi prakrtan netyapi tatrapisanpantanatran kartavyan - yasyetyatO lopo pavati, syan na (614 vipratisetopasankyanavartikan 2 ) - iyanuvanpyan lopo vipratisetena - iyanuvanpyan lopo pavati vipratisetena iyanuvanoravakasa - sriyO, sriya pruvO, pruva lopasyavakasa - kanantaleya, patravaheya ihopayan prapnoti - vatsapreya, lEkapreya lopo pavati vipratisetena (615 vipratisetopasankyanavartikan 3 ) - kunavrti ca - kunavrti ceyanuvanpyan pavato vipratisetena kunavrtyoravakasa - ceta, kO iyanuvano sa eva ihopayan prapnoti - cayanan, cayaka lavanan, lavaka kunavrti pavato vipratisetena (616 vipratisetapratyakyanavartikan 4 ) - na veyanuvanatesasyanyavisayavacanat - na varto vipratisetena kin karanan ? iyanuvanatesasyanyavisaye vacanat iyanuvanatesonyavisaye arapyate kin visaye ? yanatesavisaye sa yatEva yanatesan patate, evan kunavrti api pateta (617 pratisetopasankyanavartikan 5 ) - tasnatatra kunavrtivisaye pratiseta - tasnatatra kunavrtivisaye pratiseto vaktavya (pratisetanartakyapotakapasyan) na vaktavya natyepavata purvan vitin patanta ityevaniyanuvanateso yanatesan patisyate, kunavrti na patisyate

pk: suryatisyagastyanatsyanan ya upaDaya (3147) (618 aksepavartikan 1 ) - suryadinanananteprasidDiranganyatvat - suryadinanananteprasidDi sOri balaka kin karanan ? anganyatvat anantanetadangananyadBavati lope krte nanganyatvan sTanivadBavadanganyatvan Bavati (619 sanaDanavartikan 2 ) - sidDan tu sTanivatpratiseDat - sidDanetat kaTan ? sTanivatpratiseDat pratisiDyatetra sTanivadBava - yalopaviDin prati na sTanivadBavatiti evanapi na siDyati kin karanan ? anganyatvat anyo hi suryasabda, anya sOryasabda nEsa dosa ekadesavikrtanananyavadBavatityevan Bavisyati (620 pratyaksepavartikan 3 ) - upaDagrahananarTakyan ca - sTanivadBave cedanin pratisidDe upaDagrahanananarTakan kin karanan ? antya eva hi suryadinan yakara kin yatanetadBavati ? susWu yatan, saDu ca yatan, yadi pragBadasidDatvan aTa saha tenasidDatvan, asidDatvalopasyanantyo yakaro Bavati (sanaDanaBasyan) yadyapi saha tenasidDatvan, evanapi na dosa nEvan vijnayate - suryadinananganan yakaralopa iti kaTan tarhi ? angasya yalopo Bavati sa cetsuryadinan yakara iti evanapi suryacari atra prapnoti tasnadupaDagrahanan kartavyan (621 parigananopasanKyanavartikan 4 ) - visayaparigananan ca - visayaparigananan ca kartavyan (62 parigananavartikan 5 ) - suryanatsyayornyan - suryanatsyayornyaniti vaktavyan sOri, natsi (623 parigananavartikan 6 ) - suryagastyayosCe ca - suryagastyayosCe ca nyan ceti vaktavyan sOri, sOriya agasti, agastiya (624 parigananavartikan 7 ) - tisyapusyayornaksatrani - tisyapusyayornaksatrani yalopo vaktavya tEsan, pOsa (625 upasanKyanavartikan 8 ) - antikasya tasi kadilopa adyudatatvan ca - antikasya tasi kadilopo vaktavya, adyudatatvan ca vaktavyan antito na durat (upasanKyanaBasyan) tane tadesca kadesca lopo vaktavya agne tvan no antana antitane avarohati (upasanKyane slokavartikan) tasityesa na vaktavyo drswo dasatayepi hi dyO lopontisadityatra antisat (upasanKyane slokavartikan) taTadyO yentyaTarvasu 1 anti ye ca durake
ck: suryatisyakastyanatsyanan ya upataya (3147) (618 aksepavartikan 1 ) - suryatinanananteprasitirankanyatvat - suryatinanananteprasiti sOri palaka kin karanan ? ankanyatvat anantanetatankananyatpavati lope krte nankanyatvan stanivatpavatankanyatvan pavati (619 sanatanavartikan 2 ) - sitan tu stanivatpratisetat - sitanetat katan ? stanivatpratisetat pratisityatetra stanivatpava - yalopavitin prati na stanivatpavatiti evanapi na sityati kin karanan ? ankanyatvat anyo hi suryasapta, anya sOryasapta nEsa tosa ekatesavikrtanananyavatpavatityevan pavisyati (620 pratyaksepavartikan 3 ) - upatakrahananartakyan ca - stanivatpave cetanin pratisite upatakrahanananartakan kin karanan ? antya eva hi suryatinan yakara kin yatanetatpavati ? sustu yatan, satu ca yatan, yati prakpatasitatvan ata saha tenasitatvan, asitatvalopasyanantyo yakaro pavati (sanatanapasyan) yatyapi saha tenasitatvan, evanapi na tosa nEvan vicnayate - suryatinanankanan yakaralopa iti katan tarhi ? ankasya yalopo pavati sa cetsuryatinan yakara iti evanapi suryacari atra prapnoti tasnatupatakrahanan kartavyan (621 parikananopasankyanavartikan 4 ) - visayaparikananan ca - visayaparikananan ca kartavyan (62 parikananavartikan 5 ) - suryanatsyayornyan - suryanatsyayornyaniti vaktavyan sOri, natsi (623 parikananavartikan 6 ) - suryakastyayosce ca - suryakastyayosce ca nyan ceti vaktavyan sOri, sOriya akasti, akastiya (624 parikananavartikan 7 ) - tisyapusyayornaksatrani - tisyapusyayornaksatrani yalopo vaktavya tEsan, pOsa (625 upasankyanavartikan 8 ) - antikasya tasi katilopa atyutatatvan ca - antikasya tasi katilopo vaktavya, atyutatatvan ca vaktavyan antito na turat (upasankyanapasyan) tane tatesca katesca lopo vaktavya akne tvan no antana antitane avarohati (upasankyane slokavartikan) tasityesa na vaktavyo trsto tasatayepi hi tyO lopontisatityatra antisat (upasankyane slokavartikan) tatatyO yentyatarvasu 1 anti ye ca turake

atrapi askarasoranvacanan jnapakan - nayanacanantyatparo Bavatiti kaTan krtva jnapakan ? hyasti visesa - anyacanantyatpare satyasati va ayanasti visesosatyani dvirvacanena Bavitavyan, sati na Bavitavyan satyapi Bavitavyan kaTan ? anastanaDyapatitatvadDatugrahanena grahanat tadetatkasasoranvacanan jnapakaneva - nayanacanantyatparo(1) Bavatiti aTapi kaTan ciditkaryan syadevanapi na dosa, - kriyate nyasa eva - ananantre(2) iti yadyevanananantra iti prapnoti sakanDunyayena nirdesa aTa vastvasya grahanan ko dosa ? iha karayancakara harayancakara cikirsancakara jihirsancakara, hrasvanadyapo nuqiti nuwprasajyeta lopayadesayo krtayorna Bavisyati idaniha sanpraDaryan - lopayadesO kriyetan(2) nuqiti; kinatra kartavyan ? paratvanuw nityO lopayadesO, krtepi nuwi prapnutokrtepi tatra nityatvalopayadesayo krtayorvihataninitatvanugna Bavisyati aTasya kasnana Bavati - kinetinavyayaGadanvadravyaprakarsaiti ? ananubanDakagrahane hi na sanubanDakasyeti sa tarhyevanarTonubanDa kartavya ? nanu cavasyanugitkaryarTonubanDa kartavya narTa ugitkaryarTenanubanDena lingaviBaktiprakarane sarvanugitkaryan, na cano lingaviBakti sta avyayanesa nakarasya tarhitsanjnaparitranarTonubanDa kartavya itkaryaBavadatretsanjna na Bavisyati idanastitkaryan - nidacontyatpara ityacanantyatparo yaTa syat nEtadasti Gantadayan viDiyate tatra nasti visesa - nidacontyatpara iti va(1) paratve pratyaya para iti va paratve aTapi kaTan ciditkaryan syadevanapi na dosa - kriyate nyasa eva aTa vastvasya grahanan ko dosa ? iha-pacatitaran jalpatitaran, - hrasvanadyapo nuqiti, nuwprasajyeta lope krte na Bavisyati idaniha sanpraDarTan lopa kriyatan nuqiti, kinatra kartavyan ? paratvanuw evan tarhi hrasvanadyapo nuqityatra yasyeti loponuvartisyate aTasya kasnana Bavati neranadyaniByaiti ? kin ca syat ?

atrapi askarasoranvacanan cnapakan - nayanacanantyatparo pavatiti katan krtva cnapakan ? hyasti visesa - anyacanantyatpare satyasati va ayanasti visesosatyani tvirvacanena pavitavyan, sati na pavitavyan satyapi pavitavyan katan ? anastanatyapatitatvatatukrahanena krahanat tatetatkasasoranvacanan cnapakaneva - nayanacanantyatparo(1) pavatiti atapi katan cititkaryan syatevanapi na tosa, - kriyate nyasa eva - ananantre(2) iti yatyevanananantra iti prapnoti sakantunyayena nirtesa ata vastvasya krahanan ko tosa ? iha karayancakara harayancakara cikirsancakara cihirsancakara, hrasvanatyapo nutiti nutprasacyeta lopayatesayo krtayorna pavisyati itaniha sanprataryan - lopayatesO kriyetan(2) nutiti; kinatra kartavyan ? paratvanut nityO lopayatesO, krtepi nuti prapnutokrtepi tatra nityatvalopayatesayo krtayorvihataninitatvanukna pavisyati atasya kasnana pavati - kinetinavyayakatanvatravyaprakarsaiti ? ananupantakakrahane hi na sanupantakasyeti sa tarhyevanartonupanta kartavya ? nanu cavasyanukitkaryartonupanta kartavya narta ukitkaryartenanupantena linkavipaktiprakarane sarvanukitkaryan, na cano linkavipakti sta avyayanesa nakarasya tarhitsancnaparitranartonupanta kartavya itkaryapavatatretsancna na pavisyati itanastitkaryan - nitacontyatpara ityacanantyatparo yata syat nEtatasti kantatayan vitiyate tatra nasti visesa - nitacontyatpara iti va(1) paratve pratyaya para iti va paratve atapi katan cititkaryan syatevanapi na tosa - kriyate nyasa eva ata vastvasya krahanan ko tosa ? iha-pacatitaran calpatitaran, - hrasvanatyapo nutiti, nutprasacyeta lope krte na pavisyati itaniha sanpratartan lopa kriyatan nutiti, kinatra kartavyan ? paratvanut evan tarhi hrasvanatyapo nutityatra yasyeti loponuvartisyate atasya kasnana pavati neranatyanipyaiti ? kin ca syat ? ku

pk: trjvatkroswu striyan ca aTatra viBaktavityanuvartate utaho na ? kin cata ? trjvatstriyan(3) viBaktO cetkroswiBaktirna siDyati trjvatstriyan viBaktO cetkroswriBaktiriti na siDyati evan tarhi ikara eva trjvadBavan vaksyani tadikara grahanan kartavyan ? na kartavyan kriyate nyase eva prasrliswanirdesoyan - stri ir - stri, striyaniti ikare taninita sa ikare cet tana kin karanan ? taninita sa trjvadBavaninita sa ikara, nakrte trjvadBave ikara prapnoti kin karanan ? rneByo nibityucyate ikare ca trjvadBavastadidanitaretarasrayan(1) Bavati itaretarasrayani ca na prakalpante evan tarhi gOradisu paWadikaro Bavisyati gOradisu na paWyate nahi kin citunantan gOradisu paWyate ! evan tarhi etajnapayatyacaryo - Bavatyatra ikara iti yadayanikare trjvadBavan sasti tenEva Bavanan cetsyadaniswopi prasajyate yadyapi nasti viseso nipo va(1) niso va, ninapi tu prapnoti iha ca na prapnoti - pancaBi kroswriBi kritE raTE - pancakroswrBi raTEriti evan tarhi - nacaparan(2) ninitan sanjna ca pratyayalaksanena(3) na caparan ninitanasriyate, asninparata kroswustrjvadBavatiti (kin tarhi ?) angasya kroswustrjvadBavatyangasanjna ca Bavati pratyayalaksanena kin punarayan sastratidesa - trco yacCastran tadatidisyate, aho svidrupatidesa, trco yadrupan tadatidisyate iti ? kascatra visesa ? trjvaditi sastratidesascedyaTa cini tadvat trjvaditi sastratidesascedyaTa cini tadvatprapnoti kaTan ca cini ? uktan(1) - angasyeti tu prakaranadangasastratidesatsidDaniti angan yatkaryan tadatidisyate evanihapyanangunadirGatvanyatidiswani raparatvananatidiswan tatra ko dosa ? tatra raparavacanan(2) tatra raparatvan na siDyati, tadvaktavyan nEsa dosa gunetidiswe raparatvanapyatidiswan Bavati kaTan ? karyakalan sanjnapariBasan yatra karyan tatra draswavyan, rto nisarvananasTanayorguno Bavati upasTitanidan Bavati - uranrapara iti evan tarhi ayananyo doso jayate - ahatya trco yacCastran tadatidisyetanahatya(2) veti ? kin cata ? yadyahatya, - dirGatvanatidiswan, anangunaraparatvanyanatidiswani aTanahatya, anangunaraparatvanyatidiswani, dirGatvananatidiswan astvahatya nanu coktan dirGatvanatidiswananangunaraparatvanyanatidiswaniti nEsa dosa - dirGatvetidiswenangunaraparatvanyanayatidiswani Bavanti kaTan ? upaDaya iti vartate, na cakrtesvetesu dirGatvaBavinyupaDa(1) Bavati kuto nu Kalvetadetesu viDisu krtesu ya upaDa tasya upaDaya dirGatvan Bavisyati na puna krosworyontaratano(3) gunastasninkrtevadese ca yopaDa tasya dirGatvan Bavisyati ? nEkanudaharanan yogaranBan prayojayatiti (4) tatra trjvadvacanasarnaTyadetesu
ck: trcvatkrostu striyan ca atatra vipaktavityanuvartate utaho na ? kin cata ? trcvatstriyan(3) vipaktO cetkrostipaktirna sityati trcvatstriyan vipaktO cetkrostripaktiriti na sityati evan tarhi ikara eva trcvatpavan vaksyani tatikara krahanan kartavyan ? na kartavyan kriyate nyase eva prasrlistanirtesoyan - stri ir - stri, striyaniti ikare taninita sa ikare cet tana kin karanan ? taninita sa trcvatpavaninita sa ikara, nakrte trcvatpave ikara prapnoti kin karanan ? rnepyo nipityucyate ikare ca trcvatpavastatitanitaretarasrayan(1) pavati itaretarasrayani ca na prakalpante evan tarhi kOratisu patatikaro pavisyati kOratisu na patyate nahi kin citunantan kOratisu patyate ! evan tarhi etacnapayatyacaryo - pavatyatra ikara iti yatayanikare trcvatpavan sasti tenEva pavanan cetsyatanistopi prasacyate yatyapi nasti viseso nipo va(1) niso va, ninapi tu prapnoti iha ca na prapnoti - pancapi krostripi kritE ratE - pancakrostrpi ratEriti evan tarhi - nacaparan(2) ninitan sancna ca pratyayalaksanena(3) na caparan ninitanasriyate, asninparata krostustrcvatpavatiti (kin tarhi ?) ankasya krostustrcvatpavatyankasancna ca pavati pratyayalaksanena kin punarayan sastratitesa - trco yacastran tatatitisyate, aho svitrupatitesa, trco yatrupan tatatitisyate iti ? kascatra visesa ? trcvatiti sastratitesascetyata cini tatvat trcvatiti sastratitesascetyata cini tatvatprapnoti katan ca cini ? uktan(1) - ankasyeti tu prakaranatankasastratitesatsitaniti ankan yatkaryan tatatitisyate evanihapyanankunatirkatvanyatitistani raparatvananatitistan tatra ko tosa ? tatra raparavacanan(2) tatra raparatvan na sityati, tatvaktavyan nEsa tosa kunetitiste raparatvanapyatitistan pavati katan ? karyakalan sancnaparipasan yatra karyan tatra trastavyan, rto nisarvananastanayorkuno pavati upastitanitan pavati - uranrapara iti evan tarhi ayananyo toso cayate - ahatya trco yacastran tatatitisyetanahatya(2) veti ? kin cata ? yatyahatya, - tirkatvanatitistan, anankunaraparatvanyanatitistani atanahatya, anankunaraparatvanyatitistani, tirkatvananatitistan astvahatya nanu coktan tirkatvanatitistananankunaraparatvanyanatitistaniti nEsa tosa - tirkatvetitistenankunaraparatvanyanayatitistani pavanti katan ? upataya iti vartate, na cakrtesvetesu tirkatvapavinyupata(1) pavati kuto nu kalvetatetesu vitisu krtesu ya upata tasya upataya tirkatvan pavisyati na puna krostoryontaratano(3) kunastasninkrtevatese ca yopata tasya tirkatvan pavisyati ? nEkanutaharanan yokaranpan prayocayatiti (4) tatra trcvatvacanasarnatyatetesu vi
